notes.title: NOW WEAPONS HAVE CAMOUFLAGES - UPDATE 1.0.7
notes.content:

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 WEAPONS HAVE CAMOUFLAGE NOW 


 I worked to bring in this new update camouflages for the game's weapons, to unlock the camouflages you need to earn "CORONGA COIN", for each flu you cure you get "5 CORONGA COIN"

 This way you will accumulate enough coins to unlock all camouflages just by playing the game.

 To make the game cooler and more challenging, now the game's difficulty is progressive, with each new round the flu sufferers get faster according to the chosen difficulty.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fix animation of weapons in online mode
Online Arena map light correction
Correction of the rotation of the flu in online mode

notes.title: AMAZING NEWS FOR ONLINE AND GRIPPED MODES - UPDATE 1.0.6
notes.content:
WHAT CHANGED? 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 ADDED ITEMS 


 This incredible update brought great news to the game! Now you can fight the flu with a new weapon, ".40 TT" - Or better known as "UZI".

 Are you low on life? Don't worry now you can drink the famous "SODA" and get 150 extra life points.

 Did you arrive at a very difficult round? now you have a strong ally! A "MINEGUN" - You can buy it and build anywhere on the map.

 A short film in honor of the victims of "covid 19" was added to the game, to honor the family of the people who had their lives cut by the virus

 Now you can find out how the virus infected the world in the game universe, just see the trailer inside the game itself.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


 ERROR CORRECTION 

[olist]
 Bug fix: getting on top of furniture and catching the flu.

 Bug fix: it crashed the game when going online.

 Bug fix: that the map was not loaded online

 Bug fix: when the game is reset it loads to the wrong map
 
 OTHER VARIOUS PROBLEMS HAVE BEEN CORRECTED
[/olist]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Remembering that this is a game created by just one person, help me improve by reporting errors and giving tips.

notes.title: THE GAME IS IN NEW STYLE - UPDATE 1.0.5
notes.content:
==================================================================================

 WHAT'S THE BIG NEWS OF THE GAME? 

==================================================================================

 SHOOTING EFFECTS 

As a way of respecting the victims of Covid 19, I decided to change the ammunition that was fired at the infected. now all shots are syringes with the cure formula.

==================================================================================

 NOW GRIPPEDS HAVE 2 STAGES 

[olist]
 CORRIDOR: IN THE BEGINNING THEY ARE SUPER CONTAMINATED, THEIR MOVEMENT IS QUICK AND DISORDERED.

 NORMAL: AT THE NORMAL INTERNSHIP GRIPPEDS ARE SLower.
[/olist]

EVERY SHOT HIT IN THE GRIPPED HE IS BEING CURED.

==================================================================================

 GRAPHIC MENU DESIGN 

I wanted to bring a menu with a more Brazilian style to honor Brazil. So the entire graphic menu was remodeled, in certain points the Brazilian flag is exposed!

==================================================================================

 NEAREST CONTACT WITH THE PUBLIC 

As this is a game created by just one person and without funding, I think it is essential to extract as much feedback from the audience as possible to improve the game in all aspects.

That way, in the "ABOUT US" tab within the game, you can have quick access to my social networks!

 Added Social Networks 


 Youtube
 Instagram
 Email


==================================================================================


 NEW GAME STYLE 

Observing the criticisms and analyzes that I received, I realized that it was necessary to put more things in the game, so that the players could spend more time playing and make their 4.99 worthwhile.

Because of this, a new map emerged in the gripped mode. Codenamed "ARENA PVP".

 HOW IS THE MAP? 

The map is set in an abandoned arena, with destroyed buildings, in which your objective will be to eliminate as many armed enemies as possible. as in a classic KILL TO KILL.

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENT DEVELOPER
notes.content:
UPDATE 0.1

The development team is working hard to provide a complete game with incredible fun.

In-game features added


 Information panel on unlocked achievements, this way it will be much easier and more dynamic to visualize your achievements

 Redirect button for update notes

 Improved graphics and game menu



We have added an admin panel in history mode, in which you will be able to modify the game, for example put in round 1000. 

to access this panel you must reset the game first. then access the game files folder and enter the "easter egg" folder, to access the admin commands

New maps are in development, and new gameplay features will soon be available
